\tablenote{Companion to T6: the three source columns that T6 does not print. \emph{Elim.\ event} is the canonical event sequence of the elimination; \emph{Applied action} is the action recorded at that decision (declare\_bankruptcy for the 56 declared eliminations, mortgage\_property for the four automatic ones). \emph{Route} is the ordered own-action liquidation sequence used to compute the accessible-cash column of T6 (building sales first, then mortgages), reproduced verbatim from the source \texttt{steps} list; eight rows have an empty route because no own action raises cash.
